annotations.title: Open CI cost fixes for every app (one draft PR per repo)

description: Open the CI cost fixes from preview_ci_cost_fix_rollout as ONE draft pull request per repo (ADR 0047 amendment), so each repo runs CI once for all its fixes instead of once per fix. repos: [{ projectId, repo, items: [{ workflowPath, kind }] }], at most 10 repos and 20 items each (pass the preview's ready items). Mushi rebuilds the advice itself and opens only items it still advises (evidence and saving come from the server), skips an edit whose PR is still open or that is being opened, and counts each repo once against its project's 10 CI fix PRs an hour. In each repo it reads every workflow once, applies the kinds in turn with the same refusals as open_ci_cost_fix, and opens one draft PR with a ci: title whose body lists each change and each refusal; a refused item is never dropped, and when every item is refused no PR is opened. Nothing changes until a person reviews, readies and merges the PR. Needs the GitHub App's Workflows: Read and write permission (or a token with the workflow scope). Confirm with the user first. Returns { queued, results [{ projectId, repo, status (queued | skipped | error), bundleId, jobs, skipped [{ workflowPath, kind, code (NOT_ADVISED | PR_ALREADY_OPEN | COST_FIX_IN_PROGRESS), message, prUrl }], error { code (NOT_FOUND | FORBIDDEN | REPO_NOT_IN_PROJECT | RATE_LIMITED | COST_FIX_IN_PROGRESS | MIGRATION_PENDING), message } }] }. Follow each bundle with get_ci_cost_fix_bundle. Write.
